spans.s:
उद्वत् उद्-वत्, त्, f. (fr. 1. उद्), Ved. elevation,
a hill.

उद्वत्सर उद्-वत्सर, अस्, m. a year; (a wrong
reading for इद्-वत्सर, q. v.)

उद्वप् उद्-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्-
तुम्, to pour out; to raise, elevate.
उद्-वपन, अम्, n. pouring out, shaking out.

उद्-वाप, अस्, m. ejection; (in logic) non-existence
of a subsequent resulting from the absence of an
antecedent.

उद्वम् उद्-वम्, cl. 1. P. -वमति, -मितुम्, to
throw up, eject, vomit.
उद्-वमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, casting up, vomiting.
उद्-वमन, अम्, n. ejecting, emitting, vomiting.

उद्-वान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, vomited; (अस्), m. an ele-
phant out of rut.
उद्-वान्ति, इस्, f. ejecting, vomiting.

उद्वयस् उद्-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. (perhaps)
exciting or increasing the strength.
उद्वर्त उद्-वर्त, &c. See उद्-वृत् next col.

उद्-वर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, superfluous, redundant,
plentiful; left over as a remainder; (अस्), m. a re-
mainder, a surplus.

उद्वर्धन उद्-वर्धन, अम्, n. sly or sup-
pressed laughter.
उद्वर्हित उद्-वर्हित. See under उद्-वृह्.

उद्-वर्हित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, drawn or lifted up,
eradicated.

उद्वस् उद्-वस्, Caus. P. -वासयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to live away, to banish, expel.

1. उद्-वास, अस्, m. (for 2. see next col.), banishment,
exile; abandonment, setting free; carrying out for
slaughter, killing.

उद्वास 2. उद्-वास, अस्, आ, अम्, or उद्-वासस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, one who has put off his clothes. (For 1.
उद्-वास see under उद्-वस्.)

उद्वास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the killing of a
sacrificial animal.

उद्वह् उद्-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, -वो-
ढुम्, to carry out or away, elevate; to take or lead
away; to bear up, raise up, elevate; to marry; to
vomit (?): Caus. P. -वाहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
marry, to allow any one to expel his wife.

उद्-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying or leading up, carry-
ing away, taking up or away; continuing, propagat-
ing; eminent, superior, best; (अस्), m. son, offspring;
the fourth of the seven winds or courses of air, viz.
that of the Nakṣatras supporting these lunar con-
stellations and causing their revolution; the vital air
that conveys nourishment upwards; one of the seven
tongues of fire; N. of a prince; (आ), f. a daughter.

उद्-वाह, अस्, m. bearing up, supporting, marriage,
wedding.
—उद्वाह-कर्मन्, अ, n. the marriage
ceremony.
—उद्वाह-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a work of
Raghunandana on marriage ceremonies; [cf. विवाह-
तत्त्व.]

उद्-वहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, upholding, supporting, bear-
ing, containing; having, possessing, assuming.

उद्-वाहन, अस्, आ, अम्, drawing up, that which
raises or draws up; (अम्), n. lifting up; ploughing a
field twice; anxiety, anxious regret; marriage; (ई), f.
a cord, rope; the small shell used as a coin, a cowri.

उद्वाहिक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to marriage, matri-
monial.

उद्-वाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, lifted or pulled up;
eradicated.

उद्-वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, what raises or draws up; who or
what marries, relating to marriage; (इनी), f. a rope.
उद्वोढु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of marrying.

उद्वाचन उद्-वाचन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. crying
out (?).
उद्वादन उद्-वादन, अम्, n. crying aloud.

उद्वान उद्वान, अस्, आ, अम् (probably a cor-
rupt form), ejected, vomited; (अम्), n. ejecting, vo-
miting; a stove; [cf. उद्धान, उद्-ध्मान, उद्-
वान्त.]

उद्वाष्प उद्-वाष्प, अस्, आ, अम्, shedding tears.
—उद्वाष्प-त्व, अम्, n. the act of shedding tears.

उद्विघुष् उद्-वि-घुष्, Caus. P. -घोषयति,
-यितुम्, to declare or proclaim aloud, to cause to de-
clare aloud.

उद्विज् उद्-विज्, cl. 6. A. (ep. also cl. 6. P. and
cl. 1. P. A.) -विजते, -ति, -वेजति, -ते, -वेजितुम्, to
tremble, shake; to be agitated, grieved, or afflicted;
to fear, be afraid of (with abl. or gen.); to grieve,
afflict, frighten: Caus. P. -वेजयति, -यितुम्, to ter-
rify, frighten.
उद्-विज्; for ‘-वेजितुम्’ read -विजितुम्.

उद्वीज् उद्-वीज्, cl. 10. P. -वीजयति, -यितुम्,
to blow upon, blow towards; to fan upon.

उद्-विग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sorrowful, anxious, grieving
for an absent lover.
—उद्विग्न-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, or
उद्विग्न-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, depressed in mind,
sorrowful, anxious, distressed.
उद्-विजमान, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, afraid.

उद्-वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, going swiftly, an express
messenger, a runner, a courier, &c.; steady, com-
posed, tranquil; ascending, mounting, going up or
upwards; an ascetic whose arms by long habit con-
tinue always raised above the head; (अस्), m. trem-
bling, waving, shaking; agitation, anxiety; regret,
fear, distress occasioned by separation from a beloved
object; admiration, astonishment; उद्वेगं कृ, to
disturb, to be disturbed in mind; (अम्), n. the fruit
of the Areca Faufel; the Areca nut, called betel nut
because eaten with the betel leaf.
उद्वेग उद्-वेग. See under उद्-विज्, p. 158.

उद्वेगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing anxiety or agitation of
mind; suffering distress, anxious, unhappy.

उद्-वेजक, अस्, आ, अम्, agitating, distressing, annoy-
ing, causing pain or sorrow.

उद्-वेजन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to shake with
terror, hurting the feelings; (अम्), n. shaking with
terror, agitation, anxiety, affliction; infliction of pain,
torture; regret, sorrowing for one absent.
—उद्वेजन-
कर, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, inflicting pain, punishing,
torturing, painful.

उद्वेजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, causing terror or shaking
(with gen. of the person).
उद्-वेजित, अस्, आ, अम्, grieved, pained, afflicted.

उद्वीक्ष् उद्-वीक्ष् (उद्द्-वि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -वीक्-
षते, -षितुम्, to look up or upwards, view, look at,
perceive; to examine, consider.

उद्-वीक्षण, अम्, n. looking up or upwards;
seeing, looking at.
उद्-वीक्ष्य, ind. having looked upwards.

उद्वृ उद्-वृ, cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -णुते,
वृणाति, -णीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम् or -रीतुम्,
to elect, select, choose.
उद्वृंहण उद्-वृंहण, अम्, n. increase.

उद्वृत् उद्-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -तितुम्, to
go upwards, rise, ascend, swell; to be puffed up with
pride, to be haughty: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to come out, extirpate, eradicate, destroy.

उद्-वर्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to rise, increasing;
rubbing and cleaning the body, who or what does
so; (अस्), m. a mathematical term, the quantity
assumed for the purpose of the operation.

उद्-वर्तन, अम्, n. going up, rising, ascending;
prosperity, elevation; springing up of plants or
grain &c.; drawing out metal, laminating, wire draw-
ing; grinding, pounding; rubbing or kneading
the body; rubbing and cleaning it with fragrant
unguents; the unguents used for that purpose or to
relieve pains in the limbs &c.; bad behaviour, bad
conduct.

उद्-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, risen, elevated; sprung up,
drawn out; perfumed, scented, rubbed, kneaded,
shampooed.

उद्-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, elevated; exalted,
prosperous; vomited up; left as a remainder; ill-
conducted, ill-mannered.

उद्वृह् उद्-वृह्, cl. 6. P. -वृहति, -वर्हितुम्
or -वर्ढुम्, to raise up, elevate; to draw up, pull
out by the roots, eradicate.

उद्वेदि उद्-वेदि, इस्, इस्, इ, furnished with an
elevated altar.

उद्वेप् उद्-वेप्, cl. 1. A. -वेपते, -पितुम्, to
tremble, to be agitated.

उद्वेल उद्-वेल, अस्, आ, अम्, overflowing its
banks (as a river).
उद्वेल्लित उद्-वेल्लित, अस्, आ, अम्, tossed up.

उद्वेष्ट उद्-वेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, investing, en-
veloping, surrounding; (अस्), m. surrounding, enclos-
ing; investing a town, besieging or surrounding it.

उद्-वेष्टन, अम्, n. the act of surrounding;
oppressing; an enclosure; pain in the back of the
body; (हृदयोद्वेष्टन, convulsive pain in the
heart); (अस्, आ, अम्), unbound, unfettered, freed from
bonds or ties.

उद्-वेष्टनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be unbound or un-
fastened.

उद्-वेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, invested, en-
closed.
